mail.M1.subject: Your {plan} plan is active
mail.M1.active: Thank you. Your {plan} plan is active now.
mail.M1.price: You pay {totalAmount} a month, tax included. The plan renews on {renewDate} and then every month until you cancel.
mail.M1.cancel: You can cancel at any time in Settings, or without signing in on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M1.withdrawal: If you live in the EU, the EEA or the UK, you may withdraw within {withdrawalDays} days. You then pay only for the part already used: the larger of the days used or the credit used. The model withdrawal form is attached to this email.
mail.M1.termsAttached: The Terms you accepted are attached. The latest version is always at {termsUrl}
mail.M1.termsCurrent: Our current Terms are online at {termsUrl}
mail.M2.subject: Your Dialectical Engine receipt for {totalAmount}
mail.M2.charged: We charged {totalAmount} for your {plan} plan on {chargeDate}.
mail.M2.invoiceAttached: Your invoice {invoiceNumber} is attached to this email.
mail.M2.invoiceInSettings: Your invoice number is {invoiceNumber}. It is listed in Settings, under Subscription. For a copy, write to {merchantEmail}.
mail.M2.thanks: Thank you for using Dialectical Engine.
mail.M3.subject: The price of your {plan} plan is changing
mail.M3.change: From {chargeDate}, your {plan} plan costs {totalAmount} a month, tax included. Until then, nothing changes.
mail.M3.cancel: If you do not want to continue, cancel before that date in Settings or on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M4.subject: A yearly reminder about your {plan} plan
mail.M4.reminder: Your {plan} plan renews every month for {totalAmount}, tax included. The next renewal is on {renewDate}.
mail.M4.cancel: You can cancel at any time in Settings or on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M5.subject: We couldn't take the payment for your {plan} plan
mail.M5.notTaken: We couldn't take this month's payment for your {plan} plan. You keep your plan while we try again.
mail.M5.notTakenNoRetry: We couldn't take this month's payment for your {plan} plan, and we won't try this card again.
mail.M5.confirmCard: Your bank asked you to confirm this payment. Please confirm your card in Settings, and we'll try again.
mail.M5.bankAskedToConfirm: Your bank asked you to confirm this payment.
mail.M5.retry: We will try again on {retryDate}. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.secondTry: Our second try did not work either. We will try again on {retryDate}. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.lastTry: We will make one last try on {retryDate}. If it fails, your account moves to the Free plan, and your debates are kept. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.addCard: You keep your plan until {endDate}. To keep it after that, add a card, and we'll take the payment from it straight away: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.addCardLast: This is our last reminder. If you don't add a card by {endDate}, your account moves to the Free plan, and your debates are kept. To add a card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M6.subject: Your account is now on the Free plan
mail.M6.moved: We could not take the payment for your {plan} plan, so your account is now on the Free plan. Your debates are kept.
mail.M6.again: You can choose a plan again at any time: {pricingUrl}
mail.M7.subject: Your {plan} plan is cancelled
mail.M7.until: You keep your {plan} plan until {accessEndDate}. You will not be charged again.
mail.M7.undo: Changed your mind? You can undo this in Settings before that date: {settingsUrl}
mail.M7.endedNow: Your {plan} plan ended on {accessEndDate}. You will not be charged again.
mail.M7.again: You can choose a plan again at any time in Settings: {settingsUrl}
mail.M7.paused: Your {plan} plan won't renew, and you won't be charged again. Its paid features stay paused while the payment dispute is open. If the dispute ends in your favour, you can use them until {accessEndDate}.
mail.M8.subject: Your withdrawal is confirmed
mail.M8.refunded: Your {plan} plan has ended, and we refunded {refundAmount} to your card. Your bank may take a few days to show it.
mail.M8.nothingDue: Your {plan} plan has ended. The part you already used covers the whole price, so nothing was due back to you.
mail.M8.nothingMoreDue: Your {plan} plan has ended, and nothing more is due back to you.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.subject: We've received your withdrawal
mail.M8_RECEIVED.received: We received your withdrawal from your {plan} plan on {withdrawalDate}. Your plan has ended.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.refunding: We're refunding {refundAmount} to your card and will email you again when it's done.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.ownerReview: A refund was already made on one of your payments, so we'll check what is still due and email you within 14 days.
mail.M9.subject: Your link to cancel your Dialectical Engine plan
mail.M9.link: Open this link and press the button on the page to cancel your plan. The link works once, for 24 hours: {cancelLinkUrl}
mail.M9.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing changes.
mail.M10.subject: Your paid features are paused
mail.M10.paused: Your bank told us that a payment for your {plan} plan is disputed. Paid features are paused while the dispute is open. Your debates are kept.
mail.M10.contact: If this is a mistake, write to us at {merchantEmail}.
mail.M10_ENDED.subject: Your {plan} plan has ended
mail.M10_ENDED.ended: Your payment for the {plan} plan was given back to you through your bank, after the dispute on it. So the plan has ended, and your account is now on the Free plan; your debates are kept.
mail.M11.subject: We couldn't accept your card
mail.M11.refunded: We can't accept cards issued in that card's country, so the {refundAmount} taken or held on it goes back to your card in full.
mail.M11.planEnded: Because of this, your {endedPlan} plan has ended and your account is now on the Free plan. Your debates are kept.
mail.M11_DUPLICATE.subject: We refunded your payment
mail.M11.duplicate: A payment of {refundAmount} arrived that we could not apply, so we refunded it in full. Your account keeps the plan it has now.
mail.export.subject: Your data export is ready
mail.export.requested: You asked for a copy of your data on {requested}.
mail.export.validity: The link works until {expires} UTC, and only when you are signed in to the account that asked for it.
mail.export.notYou: If you did not ask for this, change your password and review your active sessions in Settings.
mail.moderation.debateSubject: Your debate was taken off the public page
mail.moderation.debateHidden: On {happened}, your public debate was taken off the public page for a review against our Terms.
mail.moderation.contributionSubject: Your contribution was taken off a public debate
mail.moderation.contributionRemoved: On {happened}, a contribution you made to a public debate was removed from the public page after a review against our Terms.
mail.moderation.reportSubject: Your report was taken off a public debate
mail.moderation.reportRemoved: On {happened}, a report you asked for on a public debate was removed from the public page after a review against our Terms.
mail.moderation.kept: It stays in your account, as your own.
mail.moderation.mistake: If you think this was a mistake, write to us at the address below.
mail.statement.debateHiddenSubject: Your debate is off the public page while we review it
mail.statement.debateHidden: On {happened}, we took your public debate off the public page while we review it: {itemUrl}. Nobody can read it there, in any country, until a person decides; there is no set end date. Your account and your other debates are not affected.
mail.statement.debateDecidedSubject: Our decision on your hidden debate
mail.statement.debateDecided: On {happened}, we decided that your public debate stays off the public page: {itemUrl}. Nobody can read it there, in any country, and there is no end date. It stays in your account, and your other debates are not affected.
mail.statement.contributionRemovedSubjec: We removed your contribution from a public debate
mail.statement.contributionRemoved: On {happened}, we removed a contribution you made from the public page of this debate: {itemUrl}. It is removed in every country, with no end date. It stays in your account, as your own.
mail.statement.reportRemovedSubject: We removed your report from a public debate
mail.statement.reportRemoved: On {happened}, we removed a report you asked for from the public page of this debate: {itemUrl}. It is removed in every country, with no end date.
mail.statement.correctedSubject: We corrected your text in a public debate
mail.statement.corrected: On {happened}, this debate came back on the public page with corrections to your text: {itemUrl}. We replaced the parts that broke our rules, in every country and with no end date, and kept the rest. The full statement lists the places we changed.
mail.statement.contributionAffectedSubje: Your contribution is off a public page during a review
mail.statement.contributionAffected: On {happened}, a contribution you made left the public page of this debate together with other content we are reviewing: {itemUrl}. Your own contribution was not found to break any rule. It stays in your account, and it is off the page until a person puts it back or the review ends.
mail.statement.reportAffectedSubject: Your report is off a public page during a review
mail.statement.contributionDecidedSubjec: Our decision on the debate your contribution was in
mail.statement.contributionDecided: On {happened}, we decided that this public debate stays off the public page: {itemUrl}. What you contributed there stays off it too, in every copy of the page.
mail.statement.reportDecidedSubject: Our decision on the debate your report was in
mail.statement.reportDecided: On {happened}, we decided that this public debate stays off the public page: {itemUrl}. Any report you asked for there stays off it too, in every copy of the page.
mail.statement.reportAffected: On {happened}, a report you asked for left the public page of this debate together with other content we are reviewing: {itemUrl}. Your own report was not found to break any rule. It is off the page until a person puts it back or the review ends.
mail.statement.sourceReport: This started from a report someone made with the Report button. We do not tell you who made it.
mail.statement.sourceEmail: This started from a report someone sent us by email. We do not tell you who sent it.
mail.statement.sourceAuthority: This started from an order of a public authority.
mail.statement.sourceOwn: We acted on our own initiative: nobody reported it to us.
mail.statement.automatedDecision: An automatic check read the report and took this step by itself, with no person involved yet. A person will review it.
mail.statement.automatedDetection: An AI read the report first. A person made this decision.
mail.statement.noAutomation: A person made this decision, without automated means.
mail.statement.groundNone: No rule was recorded for this step, because it was taken before we kept one. Write to office@dezbatere.ro and a person will tell you.
mail.statement.groundHold: Our Terms of Service, section 9: we can hide a public debate while we review it.
mail.statement.groundUnlawful: Our Terms of Service, section 7: do not submit or publish unlawful content.
mail.statement.groundHate: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no hate speech of any kind.
mail.statement.groundWeapons: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no instructions for crafting weapons or drugs.
mail.statement.groundSuicide: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no content encouraging suicide or harming other people.
mail.statement.groundReligious: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no religious insult.
mail.statement.groundPersonal: Our Terms of Service, section 7: do not submit personal data about other people.
mail.statement.groundIllegal: The law: the content is illegal. The full statement names the law.
mail.statement.readFull: The full statement, with the facts we relied on, is in your account: {statementUrl}
mail.statement.routes: To challenge this decision, reply to this email or write to office@dezbatere.ro within six months: a person who was not involved will review it. You can also take it to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body, or to court.
mail.flagAnswer.receipt: On {happened}, we received your report about this public debate: {itemUrl}. A person will read it, and we will tell you what we decide.
mail.flagAnswer.autoHiddenSubject: We hid the debate you reported
mail.flagAnswer.autoHidden: On {happened}, an automatic check read your report about this public debate and hid the debate, with no person involved: {itemUrl}. A person will now review it, and we will tell you what we decide.
mail.flagAnswer.autoNotFoundSubject: We have not acted on your report
mail.flagAnswer.autoNotFound: On {happened}, an automatic check read your report about this public debate and did not act on it, with no person involved: {itemUrl}. No person has read your report. If you think that is wrong, write to support@dezbatere.ro and a person will read it.
mail.flagAnswer.noBreach: On {happened}, a person read your report about this public debate and found no breach of our rules or of the law: {itemUrl}. We have not changed the debate.
mail.flagAnswer.acted: On {happened}, a person read your report about this public debate and acted on it: {itemUrl}. To protect the people involved, we do not say more about the content.
mail.flagAnswer.routes: To challenge our decision on your report, reply to this email or write to office@dezbatere.ro within six months: a person who was not involved will review it. You can also take it to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body, or to court.
mail.M12.subject: Your {plan} plan needs a card before it renews
mail.M12.intro: We'll need your card for your {plan} payment on {renewDate}.
mail.M12.expiring: The card we have expires before then.
mail.M12.missing: We couldn't keep your card from your last payment.
mail.M12.action: Please add a card in Settings before then: {cardPageUrl}
mail.withdrawalForm.title: Model withdrawal form
mail.withdrawalForm.instruction: Complete and return this form only if you wish to withdraw from the contract.
mail.withdrawalForm.notice: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service: the Dialectical Engine subscription.
mail.withdrawalForm.name: Name: ____________
mail.withdrawalForm.signature: Signature (only if this form is sent on paper): ____________
auth.pwr.proof.subject: Reset your Dialectical Engine password
auth.pwr.proof.p1: A password reset was requested for your Dialectical Engine account.
auth.pwr.proof.p2: Open this link to choose a new password:
auth.pwr.proof.p4: You must also enter a code from your current authenticator. The email link alone cannot reset your password.
auth.pwr.proof.p5: Your existing authenticator and unused recovery codes will be retained.
auth.pwr.proof.p6: If this was not you, open this link and confirm cancellation:
auth.pwr.proof.p7: Cancelling does not change your password.
auth.pwr.completed.subject: Your Dialectical Engine password was changed
auth.pwr.completed.statement: Your password was changed. All previous sessions were revoked. Your existing authenticator and unused recovery codes are unchanged. Sign in with your new password and the next code from your authenticator.
auth.pwr.cancelled.subject: Dialectical Engine password reset cancelled
auth.pwr.cancelled.statement: The password reset request was cancelled. Your password was not changed.
auth.pwr.refused.subject: Dialectical Engine password reset stopped
auth.pwr.refused.statement: The password reset request was stopped. Your password was not changed.
auth.emr.backup.proof.subject: Verify your Dialectical Engine backup email
auth.emr.backup.proof.p1: Verification of your previously bound backup email was requested after your current password and authenticator were confirmed.
auth.emr.backup.proof.p2: Open this link to verify this same backup email address:
auth.emr.backup.proof.p4: This verification cannot change your address, password or authenticator. If you did not request it, ignore this message.
auth.emr.backup.verified.subject: Your Dialectical Engine backup email was verified
auth.emr.backup.verified.p1: Your previously bound backup email was verified on the Dialectical Engine website.
auth.emr.backup.verified.p2: Your password, authenticator and recovery codes were not changed.
auth.emr.mfa.proof.subject: Recover your Dialectical Engine authenticator
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p1: Authenticator recovery was requested for your Dialectical Engine account.
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p2: Have your replacement authenticator app ready, then open this link:
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p4: You must also enter your current password. The email link alone cannot replace your authenticator.
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p5: Once both proofs are accepted, you have less than five minutes to finish setting up the replacement authenticator and save the new recovery codes.
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p6: Your existing password will stay unchanged.
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p7: If this was not you, confirm cancellation here:
auth.emr.mfa.proof.p8: Cancellation pauses credential recovery for 24 hours. Ordinary sign-in and password reset with your current authenticator remain available.
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.subject: Dialectical Engine authenticator recovery finishes in 24 hours
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p1: Someone started replacing the authenticator on your Dialectical Engine account, using your current password and a link sent to one of your email addresses.
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p2: For your safety, nothing is replaced before {notBefore}.
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p3: Until then, your current authenticator, your recovery codes and your signed-in sessions keep working.
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p4: If this was not you, cancel it here:
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p5: Cancellation pauses credential recovery for 24 hours.
auth.emr.mfa.waiting.p6: You can also cancel it from any signed-in session: open Settings, then Security.
auth.emr.mfa.finish.subject: Finish setting up your new Dialectical Engine authenticator
auth.emr.mfa.finish.p1: You can finish setting up your new authenticator now.
auth.emr.mfa.finish.p4: You will need your current password. When you finish, your old authenticator and old recovery codes stop working, and every signed-in session is signed out.
auth.emr.mfa.finish.p5: If this was not you, do not open the link. Sign in and cancel the recovery in Settings, then Security.
auth.emr.mfa.started.subject: Dialectical Engine authenticator recovery started
auth.emr.mfa.started.statement: Authenticator recovery started after your current password and a verified email proof were accepted. Your current authenticator remains active until recovery completes.
auth.emr.mfa.completed.subject: Your Dialectical Engine authenticator was replaced
auth.emr.mfa.completed.statement: Your authenticator and recovery codes were replaced. Your password stayed unchanged. All previous sessions were revoked. Sign in with your existing password and the next code from your new authenticator.
auth.emr.mfa.cancelled.subject: Dialectical Engine authenticator recovery cancelled
auth.emr.mfa.cancelled.statement: Authenticator recovery was cancelled. Your password and active authenticator were not changed. Credential recovery is paused for 24 hours.
auth.emr.mfa.refused.subject: Dialectical Engine authenticator recovery stopped
auth.emr.mfa.refused.statement: Authenticator recovery was stopped. Your password and active authenticator were not changed.
auth.acc.verification-v1.subject: Verify your email for Dialectical Engine
auth.acc.verification-v1.p1: Verify {recipient} for your Dialectical Engine account.
auth.acc.verification-v1.p2: This verification link is valid for 24 hours and expires at {expiry}.
auth.acc.verification-v1.p3: If you cannot find this message, check your spam folder.
auth.acc.verification-v1.p4: If you did not create this account, ignore this message.
auth.acc.consumer-recovery-v1.subject: Recover your Dialectical Engine account
auth.acc.consumer-recovery-v1.p1: This recovery link is valid for 15 minutes and expires at {expiry}.
auth.acc.consumer-recovery-v1.p2: You also need an unused saved recovery code. This email alone cannot recover your account.
auth.acc.consumer-recovery-v1.p3: After proving both, verify a replacement passkey or authenticator within five minutes.
auth.acc.consumer-recovery-v1.p4: If you did not request this, ignore this message.
auth.acc.security-method-changed-v1.subj: Your Dialectical Engine sign-in methods changed
auth.acc.security-method-changed-v1.p1: A sign-in method change was recorded at {expiry}.
auth.acc.security-method-changed-v1.p2: If you did not make this change, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.security-codes-regenerated-v1.s: Your Dialectical Engine recovery codes changed
auth.acc.security-codes-regenerated-v1.p: New saved recovery codes were created at {expiry}.
Previous unused codes no longer work. No recovery code is included in this email.
If you did not make this change, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.security-recovery-proved-v1.sub: Your Dialectical Engine account recovery started
auth.acc.security-recovery-proved-v1.p1: Both recovery proofs were accepted at {expiry}.
auth.acc.security-recovery-proved-v1.p2: Existing sessions have ended. Normal sign-in remains blocked until a replacement security method is verified.
auth.acc.security-recovery-proved-v1.p3: If you did not begin recovery, contact the site operator immediately.
A Dialectical Engine recovery code was used
One of your recovery codes was just used.
This happened at {expiry}. Each code works only once.
If this wasn't you, contact the site operator immediately, then change your password and create new recovery codes in Settings.
Your Dialectical Engine account recovery completed
A replacement security method was verified at {expiry}.
Previous security methods and unused saved recovery codes no longer work.
If you did not complete recovery, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.recovery-v1.subject: Confirm your Dialectical Engine recovery email
auth.acc.recovery-v1.p1: Confirm {recipient} as your optional recovery address.
auth.acc.recovery-v1.p3: Your existing verified recovery address stays active until confirmation.
auth.acc.recovery-v1.p4: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.
auth.acc.security-scheduled-v1.subject: Dialectical Engine account deletion scheduled
auth.acc.security-scheduled-v1.p2: If you did not request this action, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.security-cancelled-v1.subject: Dialectical Engine account deletion cancelled
auth.acc.security-cancelled-v1.p1: The scheduled account deletion was cancelled.
auth.acc.security-cancelled-v1.p2: If you did not request this action, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.security-completion-v1.subject: Dialectical Engine account deletion is completing
auth.acc.security-completion-v1.p1: Your account deletion has entered its irreversible completion step.
auth.acc.security-completion-v1.p2: If you did not request this action, contact the site operator immediately.
auth.acc.email-change-confirm-v1.subject: Confirm your new Dialectical Engine email
auth.acc.email-change-confirm-v1.p1: Confirm {recipient} for your Dialectical Engine account.
auth.acc.email-change-confirm-v1.p3: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message. Nothing changes until the link is opened.
auth.acc.email-change-notice-v1.subject: Your Dialectical Engine email is being changed
auth.acc.email-change-notice-v1.p1: Someone signed in to your Dialectical Engine account asked to change its email to {newEmail}.
auth.acc.email-change-notice-v1.p2: Your current address keeps working until the new one is confirmed.
auth.acc.email-change-notice-v1.p3: If this wasn't you, cancel the change by opening this link:
auth.acc.email-change-notice-v1.p4: Then sign in and review your active sessions in Settings.
auth.acc.email-change-unavailable-v1.p1: Someone asked to use this address for a Dialectical Engine account, but it already belongs to one.
auth.acc.email-change-unavailable-v1.p2: Nothing was changed. If this was you, sign in with this address instead.
auth.acc.button: If the button does not work, open this complete link:
